new_news.headline: Is Darling Ingredients' Profit Rebound And Cash Outlook Reshaping The Investment Case?
new_news.summary: Analysis of Darling Ingredients' Q1 2026 return to profitability ($134.3 million net income) and management's projected $4-6 billion cash generation from 2027-2030, emphasizing Diamond Green Diesel as a key earnings driver for the rendering and renewable fuels company.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients' Q1 2026 Profit Rebound and Cash Outlook Reshaping Investment Case
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 results with revenue of $1,550.82 million and net income of $134.31 million, followed by an Investor Day where management outlined three-year priorities and a Shelf Registration filing for ESOP-related shares worth about $356.28 million. The company projected $4–6 billion of cash generation from 2027 to 2030 to fund debt reduction, selective acquisitions, shareholder returns, and further investments in renewable fuels and collagen.

new_news.headline: May 2026 Business Report—First Quarter 2026 Solid Waste Highlights
new_news.summary: Q1 2026 solid waste earnings reports from major companies show strong pricing growth and margin expansion. RNG development supported by EPA's final RVO rule and D3 RIN stabilization around $2.40–$2.50, benefiting waste and energy service operators.

new_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Announces Full SEC Reporting Status
new_news.summary: Barrel Energy Inc. (OTC: BRLL) announced that the Company is now a fully reporting company with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), marking a major turning point in the Company's growth strategy and public market development. Barrel Energy is a diversified energy company focused on renewable energy and nutritional energy initiatives, seeking to leverage strategic acquisitions and innovative energy solutions to create long term shareholder value.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Reports Q1 2026 Results with Net Income of $134.3M and EPS of $0.83
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 net income of $134.3 million or $0.83 per diluted share, compared to a net loss of $26.2 million, or $0.16 per diluted share, for Q1 2025. The company reported total net sales of $1.6 billion for Q1 2026, compared with $1.4 billion for the same period a year ago.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Announces First-Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors announced better-than-expected Q1 2026 results with higher profitability in both operating segments as an environmental and industrial services company. First-quarter revenue rose 2% to $1.46 billion, adjusted EBITDA increased 6% to $248 million, and the company lifted its 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $1.24 billion-$1.30 billion.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 Earnings Call Highlights: Expanded EBITDA Margin and Strategic Growth
new_news.summary: Environmental Services segment posted its 16th straight quarter of year-over-year margin improvement and 18th consecutive quarter of EBITDA growth. Safety-Kleen Sustainable Solutions benefited from higher charge-for-oil pricing and improving base oil prices, with adjusted EBITDA rising 17% to $33 million.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients (DAR) Is Up 6.7% After Q1 Swing Back To Profitability
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 results showing revenue of $1,550.82 million versus $1,380.59 million a year earlier, with net income improving to $134.31 million. The sharp Q1 2026 swing back to profit and the rebound at Diamond Green Diesel directly support the key short term catalyst of margin recovery in renewable fuels.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental's Earnings Call Signals Confident Growth and Continued M&A Pipeline
new_news.summary: GFL has already closed eight acquisitions this year, including Frontier Waste Solutions, prompting an uplift to its 2026 outlook, with targets for $7.32–7.34 billion revenue and plans to deploy an additional $300–$500 million in deals during 2026. The proposed SECURE acquisition would add a hard-to-replicate disposal network in Western Canada with expected 2026 revenue of $1.5–1.6 billion.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Reports Q1 2026 Results with Record EBITDA Margin of 29.1%
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental achieved an adjusted EBITDA margin of 29.1%, the highest Q1 margin in the company's history and a 180 basis point increase over the prior year period. The company completed eight acquisitions year-to-date, including Frontier Waste Solutions, and announced a proposed acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure to strengthen operations in Western Canada.
